en.headline: Development Bureau report cites four causes for Mary Hospital lift failures
en.dek: The bureau submitted findings identifying shaft misalignment, guide rail deviations, unbalanced cabins and poor installation as main factors, with some matters referred for further investigation.
body: The Development Bureau has submitted an investigation report to the Legislative Council on the lift problems at Queen Mary Hospital's new Clinical Block 1, the bureau said.

According to the report, all 28 lifts showed varying degrees of problems. The main reasons for frequent failures included deviations in the dimensions and verticality of the lift shaft walls, deviations in the verticality of the guide rails across different floors, an unbalanced centre of gravity of the lift cabins causing them not to be completely vertical, and unsatisfactory workmanship in the installation of the lifts.

The bureau said the contractor had multiple shortcomings, including inaccurate construction, poor workmanship and lax follow-up. It has initiated internal procedures under the regulatory mechanism to take further punitive actions against the contractor, subcontractors and consultants involved. Possible other illegal acts discovered during the investigation have been referred to relevant law enforcement departments for further inquiry.

The report also noted deficiencies in the performance of Architectural Services Department project team staff, who issued a completion certificate while some lifts still lacked use permits. The Electrical and Mechanical Services Department's acceptance mechanism was found to over-rely on non-government professionals for certain aspects without sampling checks. Remedial works are continuing, with the aim of completing the remaining lifts in the fourth quarter.

zh.headline: 發展局報告指瑪麗醫院升降機故障涉四主因
zh.dek: 發展局向立法會提交調查報告，指出井道牆身偏差、導軌垂直度問題、機廂重心不平衡及安裝工藝欠妥為主要成因，部分事項已轉交執法部門調查。
body: 發展局向立法會提交瑪麗醫院新臨床大樓1升降機工程問題的調查報告。
報告指出，全部28部升降機均出現不同程度問題。頻繁故障的主因包括升降機井道牆身尺寸和垂直度出現偏差、升降機導軌垂直度在不同樓層出現偏差、升降機機廂重心不平衡導致機廂不完全垂直，以及升降機安裝工藝質素欠妥。
發展局表示，承建商在事件中出現多項過失，包括施工失準、工藝欠妥及跟進馬虎。局方已按規管機制啟動內部程序，向涉事承建商、分判商及顧問公司採取進一步懲處行動。調查過程中發現可能涉及其他違法行為，已交由有關執法部門進一步調查。
報告亦批評建築署項目團隊人員表現欠佳，在部分升降機尚未獲發准用證的情況下批出完工證明書。機電署驗收機制部分環節過度倚賴非政府專業人員核證而未作抽查。執修工程正進行，目標於第四季完成餘下升降機。
